output.question: What is AST SpaceMobile's short interest?
output.answer: As of the October 30, 2026 settlement date, the latest FINRA reporting period, AST SpaceMobile (NASDAQ: ASTS) had 67,537,225 shares sold short. ChartExchange puts that at 25.34% of float, about 266.5M float shares. That was 1,669,187 shares (+2.53%) more than the October 15, 2026 figure of 65,868,038 shares (24.72% of float). Days to cover was about 5.08, up from 3.18 in mid-October. Short interest has risen steadily from about 64.1M shares at the end of August 2026, so ASTS is still one of the most heavily shorted large-cap space stocks.

key_facts.fact: Short position on 2026-10-30 settlement date: 67,537,225 shares, 25.34% short interest (of float), days to cover 5.08, change +1,669,187 (+2.53%); float 266,476,717 shares
Short position on 2026-10-15: 65,868,038 shares, 24.72% of float, days to cover 3.18, +1,039,864 vs. 2026-09-30
The Online Investor confirms 65,868,038 shares short as of 2026-10-15, +1,039,864 from 2026-09-30, days to cover 3.18 on average daily volume of 20,728,441

passages.quote: AST SpaceMobile's latest days-to-cover reading was 3.18 days.

caveats: FINRA publishes short interest twice a month with a lag. The 2026-10-30 figure is the latest one I could open. The next settlement date is mid-November 2026.

The % of float depends on which float figure a provider uses. ChartExchange uses about 266.5M float shares and about 299.8M shares out. Other sites have shown lower percentages, such as about 16.7% of shares outstanding on StockAnalysis, because they use a different denominator, possibly including other share classes.
Days to cover depends on the average-volume window, so it varies a lot between sites and reporting periods (3.18 vs 5.08).
The 2026-10-30 data was read from a single aggregator, ChartExchange. Only the 2026-10-15 figure was cross-checked against a second source, The Online Investor.
